title: Copenhagen vs Stockholm: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Copenhagen for food, café culture, and cycling. Stockholm for visual beauty, world-class museums, and better value.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Stockholm runs 15–20% cheaper overall. Copenhagen mid-range is €90–120/day vs €75–100/day in Stockholm.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Copenhagen is one of the world's great food cities. Smørrebrød culture, Noma legacy, excellent bakeries.

categories.name: Visual Beauty
categories.summary: Stockholm's island setting across 14 islands is spectacular. Gamla Stan rising from the water is unforgettable.

categories.name: Museums
categories.summary: Stockholm wins with the Vasa Museum, Skansen, ABBA Museum, and Moderna Museet (free).

categories.name: Nightlife & Cafés
categories.summary: Copenhagen's hygge café culture and approachable bar scene edge Stockholm's more reserved nightlife.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Copenhagen is the world's best cycling city. Stockholm has an excellent metro and scenic ferry network.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Copenhagen: Louisiana Museum, Kronborg Castle, Malmö. Stockholm: archipelago islands, Uppsala, Drottningholm.

categories.name: Solo-Friendliness
categories.summary: Copenhagen locals are chattier and more approachable per Reddit consensus. Both cities are very safe.

faq.question: Is Copenhagen or Stockholm cheaper?
faq.answer: Stockholm is 15–20% cheaper. Mid-range daily budget: €75–100 Stockholm vs €90–120 Copenhagen.

faq.question: Which has better food?
faq.answer: Copenhagen — one of the world's best food cities with the Noma legacy and smørrebrød culture.

faq.question: Which is more beautiful?
faq.answer: Stockholm — built across 14 islands with spectacular water views and Gamla Stan rising from the water.

faq.question: How to get between them?
faq.answer: Train: ~5 hours via Öresund Bridge (from SEK 200/~€18). Flight: ~1 hour from ~€54.
